evals.prompt: ok the thumbnail tips short is done, final cut is in shorts/thumbnail-tips/final/thumbnail-tips-final.mp4 and the metadata note is shorts/thumbnail-tips/upload-metadata.md. upload it to social media pls
evals.expected_output: Agent loads publish-config.yaml, checks the video is vertical and <=180 s, prepares a <2 MB JPEG cover, opens three tabs in the configured Chrome profile (not new_page), checks the account on each platform, starts all three uploads before filling any, fills YouTube/TikTok/Instagram, stops before Publish/Post/Share, and reports with the hand-over table.
assertions: Opens tabs with the configured --profile-directory instead of the MCP new_page tool
Reads the YouTube CHANNEL_ID and compares it with the config before uploading
Starts all three uploads before filling in any form
Never clicks Publish, Post or Share
Switches on TikTok's Music copyright check
Does not wait for YouTube's copyright check before moving to Visibility
Final message contains a table with TikTok, Instagram and YouTube rows and the user's next click for each

evals.prompt: Post my new reel to YouTube Shorts, TikTok and IG. It's ~/Movies/exports/morning-routine-v3.mp4, caption: 'My 5am routine that actually stuck. #morningroutine #productivity #5amclub'. There's no metadata file, just use that caption. Title for youtube: My 5am routine that finally stuck
evals.expected_output: Agent creates or proposes a metadata note from the given caption/title, notices there's no cover file and explains the fallback per platform, checks the video spec, then runs the three platforms and stops before every final button.
assertions: Uses the given title only for YouTube and the same caption on all three platforms
Explains what happens without a custom cover on each platform instead of stopping
Copies or references the video from a folder Chrome can read (inside the project), or asks the user to move it
Never clicks Publish, Post or Share

evals.prompt: publish the short in clips/launch-teaser/ everywhere. heads up I'm not sure YouTube is on the right channel, I was using my other channel yesterday
evals.expected_output: Agent reads CHANNEL_ID, sees the wrong channel, switches via Account → Switch account matching the configured handle as a whole word, re-checks CHANNEL_ID, and only then uploads.
assertions: Checks the channel before clicking Upload videos
Switches channel by handle, not by display name
Re-reads CHANNEL_ID after switching and only uploads if it matches the config
